lessons.title: The Robot Assistant
lessons.content_md:
# Python & Pandas 🤖

SQL is great for pulling books off the shelf. But what if you need to read 10,000 books, highlight all the important sentences, do complex math on the numbers you find, and draw a chart?

The Magical Librarian can't do that. You need a **Robot Assistant**.

In Data Science, that robot assistant is a programming language called **Python**.

## Meet Pandas

Python by itself is powerful, but Data Scientists give Python a special toolbelt called **Pandas**. 

Pandas is a Python library that allows you to load giant spreadsheets into your computer's memory and manipulate them at lightning speed.

Imagine giving your Robot Assistant a spreadsheet with 1 million rows and saying, *"Hey Robot, find the average age of all users from Canada, and delete anyone who hasn't logged in this year."*

The Robot Assistant (Python + Pandas) does it in one second.

<flipcard front="🐍 Why is Python so popular for Data Science?" back="It is incredibly easy to read, and it has a massive ecosystem of pre-built tools (like Pandas) designed specifically for complex math and data manipulation."></flipcard>

<flipcard front="🐼 What is Pandas?" back="A powerful library in Python used for data analysis. It allows you to create 'DataFrames', which are basically super-charged, code-driven Excel spreadsheets."></flipcard>

Here is how you ask the Robot Assistant to read a file:

```python
import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('massive_file.csv')
print(data.head())
```

<flipcard front="⚡ Is Pandas faster than doing it by hand?" back="Yes! Pandas is built on top of lower-level C code, making it capable of crunching millions of data points exponentially faster than a human ever could."></flipcard>
